reviews.review_text: On January 19th my husband and I and family went to lunch to say goodbye to Peru after having spent 1 month on vacation and returning to Switzerland where we live.  The very very warm welcome as are the puruan people, the frame, the place, decoration and atmosphere very cheerful worth the redundancy! We were greeted with a shot of warm tiger milk or something very complimentary with chiffons. We had in the group of 7, my 2 little 4 nephews and a 20 month old baby and we got a nice table on the terrace and a chair for the baby. The George took care of us wonderfully. His explanations about the dishes put water in our mouths and the final result exceeded our expectations. The picadito picantero, dry Chabelo and majado de yuca I loved! ; the classic sebiche with the fishing of the day not to mention, the wood-fired octopus macerated in chicha de jora and jíes for 24 hours will remain in our taste memory for a long time! And the duck stew with pepian how rich! Pure fish chick no longer! And when it came to ordering drinks the cocktails of La Alegria (its improved version of pisco sour) made us even more joyful! Don't have purple chicha or lemonade on the menu but they weren't missed because the coconut water in their own coconut, the mango plum soda, the barley and the tamarind water were more than fine!  As for desserts, we only ordered the reinvented 3-star pionono with coconut ice cream and carobine honey. There were other rich options but we no longer had space! Although for a delicious complimentary carobine cocktail! Anyway we will return on our next trip to Peru to try other exquisite dishes and desserts! I highly recommend this restaurant of piuran food that as the name suggests left me that feeling of Alegria and the pride of being Peruvian. How delicious is eaten in Peru and this time the piuran food came to my soul!
reviews.title: Delicious experience in the restaurant Alegria - what a delicious piuran food!

Este es un restaurante muy popular, que se ha ganado su fama con su comida. Hubo un gran tiempo de espera, pero la verdad se olvida casi completamente al probar la comida.

5/5 estrellas, lo recomiendo 
This is a very popular restaurant that has earned its fame with its food. There was a long wait, but honestly, you almost completely forget about it once you taste the food.
We waited for about 20 minutes; we were a family of four, and the service was incredible. It felt very welcoming to eat here.

5/5 stars, I recommend it

We visited Alegria Picantería Piurana accompanied by a friend who guides us around Peru, and the experience exceeded all our expectations. The food was simply delicious, an authentic trip to the northern flavors.
However, what raised our food to another level was the attention. We want to make special mention of Monica, whose professionalism captivated us. Not only did he advise us with total success, but he enriched our food explaining the origin and history of each dish. In a world where humane treatment is sometimes neglected, Monica shines with warmth and closeness.
If you are looking not only to eat well, but to understand Peruvian gastronomic culture, this is the place. We will repeat without a doubt!

reviews.review_text:
Today I had lunch at Alegría Picantiería Piurana and the experience was spectacular from beginning to end. The food completely exceeded my expectations, with that authentic taste of northern Peru and a quality that is seen on each dish.

We tried several options and everything was amazing:
• The octopus to the wood was certainly one of the best I have ever eaten: tender, juicy and with a perfect smoky touch.
• The dry of re with beans was delicious, with soft meat and well-concentrated taste.
• The rice with seafood came very well prepared, tasty and with a lot of seafood.
• Pichs like the aji of the house, the little tiger's milk and the chifles accompanied everything perfect.
• We closed with a chumbeque and an algarrobin liquor that completed the experience.

In addition, I would particularly like to highlight the attention of Monica Villlalva, who made the visit even better. He was kind, attentive, and he was pending every detail throughout the service. This level of closeness and professionalism is greatly appreciated.

In short: excellent food, pleasant atmosphere and a first-class service.

Totally recommended and definitely a place I'll come back to.
reviews.title: Experience was spectacular from beginning to end.
